sharedPrompt.format: One full-bleed illustration that fills the whole image edge to edge. Flat 2D illustration, no 3D rendering, no photorealism.
sharedPrompt.artStyle: Black-and-white pen-and-ink cartoon in the macabre, deadpan manner of mid-century magazine gag cartoons, in the spirit of Charles Addams: confident scratchy dip-pen ink lines, soft grey ink-wash and charcoal shading, heavy pools of black shadow, crumbling Victorian gothic interiors with cobwebs, candelabras and tall dusty windows, and overgrown grounds with dead trees and iron railings. The family members wear old-fashioned mourning clothes and have sunken eyes, long pale faces or round pale faces, and small knowing smiles, all delivered with a perfectly straight face. Palette: only black, white and the greys of ink wash, with no colour anywhere. Texture: slightly toothy paper, a little ink bleed. Overall mood: morbid, elegant and quietly funny.
frame: Border: a thick border of deep purple velvet, like an old Victorian photograph album, with a tarnished silver filigree edge, black rose vines with thorns twining along it, and faint cobwebs in the corners.
Top-left corner: a small round emblem of a single black rose on a deep purple ground with a thin silver ring, with no letters.

Top: an empty name banner shaped like a long engraved tarnished-silver nameplate with rounded ends and small screw heads, like the plate on a coffin or an old portrait frame, about 10% of the card height, with no letters in it.

Bottom: a pale text panel below the window, about a quarter of the card height, in pale bone white like old paper, with a thin black edge. The upper half of the panel is empty space for flavour text. A thin black divider line runs across the middle of the panel.

Stats row: the lower half of the panel is split into three equal cells by thin vertical black dividers. All three cells are pale bone white. Each cell has one small bold icon on its left side, no wider than a quarter of the cell, and the right three-quarters of the cell is empty space for a word like 'FINGERS' and a large number. The icons, left to right: one wide staring eye; one hand with its five fingers spread; one bare foot with its toes showing. The icons are simple, flat and bold, drawn in black ink only.

Card number: below the panel, on the border, in the bottom-right corner only, one wide empty black plaque with a tarnished silver edge for the card number, about 22% of the card width, so it can hold text like '#50 of 50'. The bottom-left corner has no badge, only border. The plaque is empty, with no letters.
Accent colours on the frame are only deep purple, plum, black, tarnished silver and bone white. Do not use pink, magenta or hot pink anywhere on the frame.
sharedPrompt.negative: No colour, no photorealism, no 3D render, no anime, no modern vector or flat-design look, no gore, no blood, no text, no signature, no watermark, no real people, no real or existing cartoon characters, no Addams Family characters.

rulesCard.title: How to Play
steps: Two players. Deal all the cards evenly.
Each player shuffles their cards into a face-down deck.
Each player turns over their top card and looks at it.
The winner of the last round picks a stat. In the first round, the player with the coldest hands picks.
Reveal the cards. The higher value in the called stat wins.
The winner keeps both cards in their own pile. On a tie, each player keeps their own card.
When your deck runs out, shuffle your pile to make a new deck.
You win when your opponent has no cards left. The last one standing inherits the manor.
rulesCard.framePrompt: The front of one vertical trading card, seen flat and straight on, filling the whole image edge to edge, in black-and-white pen-and-ink cartoon style with grey ink wash on a deep purple ground. The same thick deep purple velvet border with a tarnished silver filigree edge, black rose vines with thorns and faint cobwebs in the corners. The same round emblem in the top-left corner: a single black rose on a deep purple ground with a thin silver ring. The same empty engraved tarnished-silver nameplate with rounded ends and screw heads along the top. Below the nameplate, filling the rest of the card down to the border, one large empty panel in even pale bone white like old paper, with a thin black edge, with no icons, dividers or badges. No text, letters or numbers anywhere. Do not use pink or magenta.

cardBack.prompt: The back of one vertical trading card, seen flat and straight on, filling the whole image edge to edge, in black-and-white pen-and-ink cartoon style with grey ink wash on a deep purple ground. A symmetrical design, mirrored top to bottom, the same when turned upside down: a thick deep purple velvet border with a tarnished silver filigree edge and black rose vines with thorns twining along it. The centre is deep purple velvet with faint cobwebs. In the exact middle, a round tarnished silver medallion holding a single large black rose. Around the medallion, a full wreath of black roses, black leaves and thorns, drawn in black ink with grey wash, identical above and below. No text, letters or numbers. Do not use pink or magenta.

cards.name: Grandmother Mortensia
cards.character: A tiny, ancient matriarch in a high-collared black lace gown and a widow's veil pushed back, holding a lorgnette up to her sharp, sunken eyes
cards.poseAndExpression: Peering through her lorgnette at the viewer with a thin, satisfied smile
cards.backgroundScene: A dim drawing room with a tall grandfather clock, dusty portraits and a candelabra
cards.flavourText: She has outlived four husbands and one house.

cards.name: Uncle Fenwick
cards.character: A tall, gaunt uncle in a black tailcoat with impossibly long, thin fingers, a bald domed head and deep hollow eyes
cards.poseAndExpression: Seated at a pipe organ, fingers spread across three keyboards at once, head tilted back in bliss
cards.backgroundScene: A cavernous music room with organ pipes rising into darkness and cobwebs between them
cards.flavourText: He plays the organ every night, whether or not anyone asked.

cards.name: Cousin Ocularis
cards.character: A small round boy in a sailor suit whose head, hands and knees are dotted with dozens of blinking eyes of different sizes
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing politely with hands folded, every eye looking in a different direction
cards.backgroundScene: A nursery with a rocking horse missing its head and a tall barred window
cards.flavourText: He sees everything, and tells Grandmother.

cards.name: Aunt Hortensia
cards.character: A severe aunt in a black gardening apron over a mourning dress, a wide black sun hat, and long gloves
cards.poseAndExpression: Feeding a dripping piece of meat to a huge toothed plant with a fond expression
cards.backgroundScene: A ruined glasshouse full of enormous snapping plants, vines and broken panes
cards.flavourText: The roses are doing beautifully this year, except for the postman.

cards.name: Grimsby the Butler
cards.character: An enormous, silent butler with a huge square head, a stiff black uniform, white gloves and a face that never changes
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing to attention with a silver tray, looming over the viewer, expressionless
cards.backgroundScene: A long dark hallway with suits of armour and a door that stands slightly open
cards.flavourText: He has not spoken since 1871 and sees no reason to start.

cards.name: Little Mildew
cards.character: A pale, solemn little girl with two long black plaits, a black pinafore dress and white stockings, holding a headless doll by the arm
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing very still and staring straight at the viewer without blinking
cards.backgroundScene: A nursery corridor lined with small portraits, one of them turned to the wall
cards.flavourText: She is not allowed to bring the doll's head to dinner.

cards.name: Baby Obadiah
cards.character: A plump baby in a black christening gown and bonnet, with a full grey beard, bushy eyebrows and a knowing look
cards.poseAndExpression: Sitting up in an iron cot, chewing on a pocket watch
cards.backgroundScene: A gloomy nursery with a crooked mobile of bones over the cot
cards.flavourText: He was born on a Tuesday, looking exactly like this.

cards.name: Great-Uncle Phineas
cards.character: A translucent, faintly glowing ghost of a stout Victorian gentleman in a frock coat, with mutton-chop whiskers and a monocle, his legs fading away to mist
cards.poseAndExpression: Floating through the dining-room wall carrying a cup of tea, looking mildly put out
cards.backgroundScene: A formal dining room with a long table laid for twenty and no one in the chairs
cards.flavourText: He died in 1852 and still comes down for breakfast.

cards.name: Cousin Dangle
cards.character: A thin young man in a black suit hanging upside down by his feet, with slicked hair that somehow stays flat and a serene expression
cards.poseAndExpression: Hanging from the chandelier with arms folded, perfectly content
cards.backgroundScene: A grand entrance hall with a huge chandelier and a sweeping staircase in shadow
cards.flavourText: He prefers the view from up there.

cards.name: Ash and Ember
cards.character: Identical twin girls with bobbed black hair and matching black dresses with white collars, standing shoulder to shoulder under one black umbrella
cards.poseAndExpression: Both looking at the viewer with the same tiny, unsettling smile, one holding the umbrella
cards.backgroundScene: An overgrown garden path in the rain, with a leaning iron gate
cards.flavourText: They finish each other's silences.

cards.name: Nanny Thistlewick
cards.character: A stern, bony governess in a black bonnet and buttoned-up black dress, with a raven perched on her shoulder and a cane
cards.poseAndExpression: Pointing her cane sharply at the viewer, lips pursed, the raven glaring too
cards.backgroundScene: A schoolroom with a chalkboard, a skeleton on a stand and a dunce's stool
cards.flavourText: Lessons begin at midnight and end when she says so.

cards.name: Cousin Pollux
cards.character: A cheerful boy in a striped jersey with six fingers on each hand, freckles and a gap-toothed grin
cards.poseAndExpression: Holding both hands up proudly to show them off
cards.backgroundScene: A playroom with an abacus, a chess set and toy soldiers lined up for a funeral
cards.flavourText: He is very good at the piano and very bad at gloves.

cards.name: Aunt Vesper
cards.character: An elegant, deathly pale aunt in a sweeping black velvet gown with a high collar, long black hair, dark lips and heavy-lidded eyes
cards.poseAndExpression: Descending a staircase at dusk with one hand on the banister, looking down at the viewer
cards.backgroundScene: A grand staircase with a tall window showing a crescent moon, and heavy drawn curtains
cards.flavourText: She does not come down until the sun is safely gone.

cards.name: Uncle Barnabus
cards.character: A huge, broad uncle whose arms and shoulders are gnarled bark and branches, with twigs for hair and a black waistcoat buttoned over a trunk
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing rooted in the lawn with a bird's nest on his head, looking patient
cards.backgroundScene: A dead orchard behind the manor under a grey sky, with crows in the branches
cards.flavourText: He has not moved since the spring of 1879.

cards.name: Cousin Marrow
cards.character: A dapper skeleton in a quilted smoking jacket and cravat, with a cigar holder and a cheerful grin
cards.poseAndExpression: Reclining in a wing-back armchair with legs crossed, feet up on a footstool
cards.backgroundScene: A library with towering bookshelves, a roaring fire and a bear-skin rug that is still alive
cards.flavourText: He keeps himself together remarkably well.

cards.name: Mother Lucretia
cards.character: A tall, serene mother in a long clinging black gown, with straight black hair that reaches the floor, pale skin and large calm eyes
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing gracefully with her hands clasped, gazing at the viewer with quiet pride
cards.backgroundScene: A moonlit conservatory with dead ferns and a stone fountain
cards.flavourText: She has never once raised her voice, or her eyebrows.

cards.name: Father Ambrose
cards.character: A dapper, moustachioed father in a pinstriped suit with a flower in his buttonhole, bright wild eyes and brilliantined hair
cards.poseAndExpression: Lunging in a fencing pose with a foil, beaming with delight
cards.backgroundScene: A long gallery of ancestral portraits with the frames all slightly crooked
cards.flavourText: He fences the suits of armour every morning, and sometimes wins.

cards.name: The Attic Lodger
cards.character: A large, shapeless mass of shadow with many pale round eyes of different sizes, squeezed under the rafters
cards.poseAndExpression: Peering down through the attic trapdoor with every eye wide open
cards.backgroundScene: A dusty attic full of trunks, dressmaker's dummies and a rocking chair rocking by itself
cards.flavourText: Nobody remembers inviting it, so it must be family.

cards.name: Cousin Sprocket
cards.character: A clockwork boy with a brass face, glass eyes, a winding key in his back and a neat black Eton suit
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing stiffly with one arm raised mid-wave, slightly wound down
cards.backgroundScene: A workshop with gears, bell jars and a workbench of spare parts
cards.flavourText: He must be wound every evening or he stops mid-sentence.

cards.name: Grandfather Thaddeus
cards.character: The painted portrait of a fierce old man in a military coat with a huge beard, whose eyes and mouth move within the canvas
cards.poseAndExpression: Leaning out of the picture frame, pointing and shouting at someone out of view
cards.backgroundScene: A hallway wall hung with portraits, cobwebs and a gas lamp
cards.flavourText: He still runs the household from the north wall.

cards.name: Aunt Wisteria
cards.character: A refined aunt in a black bustle dress whose neck is impossibly long and curves gracefully up toward the ceiling
cards.poseAndExpression: Bending her neck down to peer at the viewer with mild curiosity
cards.backgroundScene: A tea parlour with a tall ceiling and a very high mirror
cards.flavourText: She finds most conversations rather beneath her.

cards.name: Mrs. Gristle the Cook
cards.character: A stout, red-cheeked cook in a black dress, white apron and mob cap, with brawny arms and a cleaver
cards.poseAndExpression: Holding the cleaver and smiling warmly, with something unseen wriggling in the pot behind her
cards.backgroundScene: A vast stone kitchen with hanging pots, a huge black range and a cauldron
cards.flavourText: Nobody asks what is for dinner, and nobody leaves any.

cards.name: Cousin Flotsam
cards.character: A damp, pale young man with seaweed in his hair, webbed hands and feet, and a soaked black suit
cards.poseAndExpression: Climbing out of a stone well, dripping, with a polite wave
cards.backgroundScene: The manor's garden well under a dead tree, with mist on the ground
cards.flavourText: He moved into the well for the quiet.

cards.name: Uncle Mortlake
cards.character: A tall, thin undertaker uncle in a black top hat and frock coat, with a measuring tape and a mournful face
cards.poseAndExpression: Measuring the viewer with the tape, one eyebrow raised, taking notes
cards.backgroundScene: A parlour with a coffin on trestles, lilies and a black-draped mirror
cards.flavourText: He likes to measure the guests, just in case.

cards.name: Little Gristle
cards.character: A small round boy in a black jacket with a grubby collar, a wide grin and a spider dangling from his hand
cards.poseAndExpression: Dangling a spider over his open mouth with great anticipation
cards.backgroundScene: A cellar staircase with cobwebs in every corner
cards.flavourText: He is told not to eat between meals, so he eats during them.

cards.name: Cousin Umbra
cards.character: A girl who exists only as a flat black shadow on the wall, with the outline of a dress, plaits and a hair bow
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing on the wallpaper with one hand raised in a shy wave
cards.backgroundScene: A parlour wall with striped wallpaper and a gas lamp casting long shadows
cards.flavourText: She is only ever seen out of the corner of the eye.

cards.name: Old Mould the Gardener
cards.character: A hunched, mossy old gardener in a tattered black coat and a hat with mushrooms growing from the brim, with a lichen beard
cards.poseAndExpression: Leaning on a spade beside a freshly dug hole, tipping his hat
cards.backgroundScene: A graveyard of family plots behind the manor, with crooked headstones and a wheelbarrow
cards.flavourText: He has dug the same hole every morning for forty years.

cards.name: Aunt Cordelia
cards.character: A spiritualist aunt in a black turban and shawl, with heavy kohl eyes and rings on every finger
cards.poseAndExpression: Seated at a round table with both hands flat on it, eyes rolled upward in a trance
cards.backgroundScene: A séance room with a crystal ball, a floating trumpet and a curtained doorway
cards.flavourText: She speaks to the dead, mostly to ask them to keep it down.

cards.name: Cousin Pendulum
cards.character: A gangly boy in a black suit with his hair standing straight up, swinging on the pendulum of a giant clock
cards.poseAndExpression: Mid-swing, arms outstretched, with an expression of pure joy
cards.backgroundScene: The inside of the manor's clock tower, with huge gears and a bell
cards.flavourText: He has been late for every meal since he started.

cards.name: Doctor Hemlock
cards.character: A thin, bespectacled uncle in a black physician's coat, with a bag of leeches and a stethoscope
cards.poseAndExpression: Holding up a fat leech to the light with professional interest
cards.backgroundScene: A consulting room with anatomical charts, jars of specimens and a reclining couch
cards.flavourText: He prescribes leeches for everything, including boredom.

cards.name: Great-Aunt Agatha
cards.character: The living head of a sharp-eyed old lady in a lace cap, resting comfortably in an open hatbox lined with silk
cards.poseAndExpression: Looking up from the hatbox with a bright, interested expression
cards.backgroundScene: A dressing room with hatboxes stacked to the ceiling
cards.flavourText: The rest of her is coming by a later train.

cards.name: Cousin Lupin
cards.character: A shaggy, wolfish boy in a sailor suit, with pointed ears, fur on his hands and feet and a long tongue
cards.poseAndExpression: Sitting on the floor, scratching behind one ear with a foot
cards.backgroundScene: A mud room with boots, coats and a very chewed umbrella stand
cards.flavourText: He is a perfectly good boy for most of the month.

cards.name: Uncle Pyre
cards.character: A stout, cheerful uncle in a smouldering black suit, permanently on fire from the collar up, with a lit cigar
cards.poseAndExpression: Warming his hands on his own head, chuckling
cards.backgroundScene: A smoky study with scorched armchairs and a singed rug
cards.flavourText: He is the only one allowed near the curtains.

cards.name: Aunt Nettle
cards.character: A sharp little aunt in black with spectacles on a chain, knitting furiously, with a black scarf that trails across the whole room
cards.poseAndExpression: Knitting at tremendous speed without looking, needles a blur
cards.backgroundScene: A sitting room where the scarf winds around every chair and out of the door
cards.flavourText: She started the scarf in 1868 and sees no reason to stop.

cards.name: The Visitor
cards.character: A faded, dusty gentleman in an old-fashioned frock coat and cravat, with cobwebs on his shoulders and a patient smile
cards.poseAndExpression: Sitting bolt upright in a dining chair with his hat on his knee, waiting
cards.backgroundScene: The dining room, with a place still laid for him and a very old cake
cards.flavourText: He came to dinner in 1887 and is still waiting for the soup.

cards.name: Cousin Snuffle
cards.character: A small round ball of dark fur with two huge eyes, wearing a lace bonnet
cards.poseAndExpression: Sitting on a cushion looking up adoringly
cards.backgroundScene: A parlour with a tasselled cushion on a tall chair
cards.flavourText: Nobody knows which side of the family it came from.

cards.name: Beelzebub the Cat
cards.character: A wrinkled hairless cat with huge pale eyes, wearing a tiny black ribbon
cards.poseAndExpression: Sitting upright on a cushion, staring directly at the viewer, unblinking
cards.backgroundScene: A windowsill with dead flowers in a vase and a view of the graveyard
cards.flavourText: The cat answers to no one, and the family respects that.

cards.name: Cousin Stilts
cards.character: An impossibly tall, thin boy in a short black jacket whose legs go on for yards and end in enormous feet
cards.poseAndExpression: Ducking under a doorway with his head sideways and a sheepish smile
cards.backgroundScene: A hallway with a very low doorway and scuff marks on the ceiling
cards.flavourText: He has not fitted through a door since he was nine.

cards.name: Aunt Morrow
cards.character: A thin, weeping aunt in a black veil, with huge wet eyes, a handkerchief and a watering can
cards.poseAndExpression: Watering a row of black flowers with her own tears, sniffing
cards.backgroundScene: A windowsill of potted black flowers beside a rain-streaked window
cards.flavourText: The flowers have never been better.

cards.name: Uncle Quill
cards.character: A short, prickly uncle covered in sharp black spines, wearing a black waistcoat with holes for the spines and tiny spectacles
cards.poseAndExpression: Curled halfway into a ball in an armchair, looking round and content
cards.backgroundScene: A parlour with a badly punctured armchair and a torn cushion
cards.flavourText: He gives the warmest hugs, and nobody accepts them.

cards.name: The Sisters Grimwood
cards.character: Three withered old aunts in matching black bonnets, joined at the shoulder, passing a single glass eye between them
cards.poseAndExpression: Huddled together, one holding the eye up to look at the viewer
cards.backgroundScene: A dim parlour with three teacups and one saucer
cards.flavourText: They take turns seeing, and they never agree on what they saw.

cards.name: Cousin Ratchet
cards.character: A neat girl in a black dress with a pocket apron full of teeth, pliers in one hand and a pleasant smile
cards.poseAndExpression: Holding up a tooth to the light, pleased with it
cards.backgroundScene: A bedroom with a glass cabinet full of labelled teeth
cards.flavourText: She collects teeth, and the family sleeps lightly.

cards.name: Old Mister Wick
cards.character: A gaunt caretaker in a black coat whose head is a tall white candle with a flickering flame, dripping wax down his shoulders
cards.poseAndExpression: Shuffling along a corridor carrying a ring of keys, lighting the way
cards.backgroundScene: A dark corridor with doors on both sides and wax drips on the floor
cards.flavourText: He gets shorter every winter.

cards.name: Cousin Fathom
cards.character: A pale boy with gills on his neck, round black eyes and slicked wet hair, in a soaked black suit
cards.poseAndExpression: Sitting at the bottom of a bathtub, fully clothed, waving up through the water
cards.backgroundScene: A bathroom with a claw-footed tub and a dripping tap
cards.flavourText: He takes his baths very seriously, and very long.

cards.name: Corvus the Raven
cards.character: A large, glossy black raven with a bright beady eye and a tiny black mourning ribbon around its neck
cards.poseAndExpression: Perched on a skull, head cocked, examining the viewer
cards.backgroundScene: A study with a bust on a plinth, a desk and a snuffed candle
cards.flavourText: It has learned one word, and uses it constantly.

cards.name: Baby Lamia
cards.character: A rosy baby in a black christening bonnet whose lower half is a long, coiled serpent's tail
cards.poseAndExpression: Coiled happily in a wicker basket, holding a rattle, smiling with tiny fangs
cards.backgroundScene: A nursery with a basket by the fire and a hissing kettle
cards.flavourText: She has her mother's eyes and her father's tail.

cards.name: Uncle Grimald
cards.character: A gentleman made entirely of grey fog in the shape of a frock coat and top hat, with two faint pale eyes
cards.poseAndExpression: Drifting through a keyhole, hat first, politely
cards.backgroundScene: A locked door in a dark corridor, with fog curling under it
cards.flavourText: He never knocks, because he never has to.

cards.name: Aunt Sable
cards.character: A smiling, elegant aunt in a black silk dress and a cameo brooch, carrying a silver tea tray with one steaming cup
cards.poseAndExpression: Offering the cup to the viewer with a gracious smile
cards.backgroundScene: A tea parlour with a cabinet of small labelled bottles behind her
cards.flavourText: She insists you try the tea.

cards.name: The Headless Groom
cards.character: A headless man in a dusty wedding suit and a white buttonhole, holding a ring box, with a stiff upright collar and nothing above it
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing patiently at the altar with the ring box open
cards.backgroundScene: The manor's private chapel with cobwebbed pews and dead flowers
cards.flavourText: He is still waiting for the bride, and his head.

cards.name: Mortimer, the Heir
cards.character: A tiny, serious boy in an oversized black top hat and a frock coat that trails on the floor, holding an enormous iron key
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing on the front steps with the key held in both hands, chin up
cards.backgroundScene: The grand front door of Gloomsbury Manor, with gargoyles and a brass knocker
cards.flavourText: One day all of this will be his, including the attic.
